parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, which is lightweight and durable.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the right side of the wearer’s head and ensures stability.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, primarily made of polycarbonate and optical-grade plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the main optical function of vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structure connecting both legs.
